turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Hi! One example first.
"My friends are here." "My friends" means "they", so I use "are".
Rule: I goes with am, he/she/it with is, you/we/they with are.
Right: The room is big. Wrong: The room big.

Now you. Write the missing word:
Write am, is or are: I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
